messages.author: 67ad43f188b9c5e7
messages.subject: multipleGroup: Error in serialize(data, node$con) : error writing to connection
parts:
Hi Phil and all,

I encountered a seemly simple question, but cannot figure out...

model <- multipleGroup(data, 1, group)


Here is my code to test DIF, and it works for other datasets; I am not so sure why error (Error in serialize(data, node$con) : error writing to connection
) occurred while I use this dataset. I doubled checked my data and it seems fine. I tried to track down the mirt package document, but cannot find the answer, still. 

Any thought of this?

Thanks in advance!

Yingyi
